description: 雲林縣土庫鎮公所辦理98年度莫拉克颱風農業天然災害現金救助作業弊失案檢討專案報告 [disaster risk and hazard maps and typhoons, cyclones and storms] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 法務部廉政署. 雲林縣土庫鎮公所辦理98年度莫拉克颱風農業天然災害現金救助作業弊失案檢討專案. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 法務部廉政署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-09-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
